disagreements.about: how many Arizona city/town governments there are

counts.source: Arizona Secretary of State, Jurisdictions.txt (City/Town filing jurisdictions)

disagreements.whyItIsNotReconciledHere: Two authorities counting two slightly different things: a CAMPAIGN-FINANCE FILING jurisdiction is not identical to a Census MUNICIPAL government, and the two files were produced four years apart. Both are recorded. Silently choosing either number would be inventing a denominator, and averaging them would be worse.

counts.source: A.R.S. § 16-928 — names community college district elections as a routed class
2022 Census of Governments — no Arizona unit is classified as one

disagreements.whyItIsNotReconciledHere: The statute names a class of election this repository holds NO enumeration of. That is an OPEN ENUMERATION OBLIGATION, not a finding that Arizona has no community college districts. Naming them from memory would be a fabrication in a denominator.

BALLOT_AND_CANDIDATES:STATEWIDE:az-sos-c.authorityBasis: the Secretary of State certifies and publishes statewide and legislative candidate lists
